# Text formatting

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/text-formatting.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The markup tags text strings may carry, in the order of the executable's tag table
([GUI, Markup tags](../research/gui.md#markup)). A tag with a trailing space (shown as ␠) takes an argument.
